company.name: Repeat App
company.shortDescription: Repeat App is at the forefront of consumer-driven restaurant tech, integrating discovery, mobile payment and loyalty into one platform.
company.description:
Repeat offers restaurant customers the ability to search, discover, pay and get personalized rewards based on their loyalty - the only restaurant app that proposes all of these features in one single platform in the UAE and now also in the US (starting in Texas). Appealing to a new generation of restaurant lovers, Repeat offers a personalized experience unique to each user thanks to its advanced
filtering system for easier discovery of restaurants and its disruptive behavior-based reward system.
With more data generated from these features than any other app in the industry, Repeat is actively solving one of the largest unfulfilled restaurant problems in the World: data-driven marketing to generate incremental revenue.
